name: @diffity
description: Hosted, multi-user diffity: a GitHub-style review page for agents' findings, and an MCP endpoint that writes them

scripts.build: npm run build -w @diffity/parser && npm run build -w @diffity/api && npm run build -w @diffity/ui && npm run build -w @diffity/server
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @diffity/server

author: Natural Cycles
